avoid_supplements.name: Phosphodiesterase-5 inhibitors (sildenafil, tadalafil, vardenafil)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Both nitrates and PDE-5 inhibitors cause vasodilation via nitric oxide pathway; combined use results in severe, potentially life-threatening hypotension
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated. Patients must avoid all PDE-5 inhibitors. Counsel on cardiac risks.

avoid_supplements.name: Riociguat (soluble guanylate cyclase stimulator)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct additive vasodilation through same final pathway; results in severe hypotension and syncope
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated. Do not co-administer under any circumstances.

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate antiplatelet effects and increase bleeding risk; enhances vasodilation
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation exceeding 400 IU daily. Monitor for bleeding signs.

caution_supplements.name: Garlic supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild antiplatelet and vasodilatory properties; potential additive hypotensive effect
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor blood pressure. Inform patient of potential additive effects.

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause mild vasodilation and interact with blood pressure regulation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure response; use only under supervision if needed.

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild cardiovascular effects; possible additive hypotensive response
caution_supplements.action: Use with caution; monitor for excessive blood pressure reduction.

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase nitroglycerin bioavailability and hypotensive effects; also increases metabolite levels
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit products. No consumption within 24 hours of nitroglycerin use.

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Excessive sodium may cause fluid retention and reduce antihypertensive efficacy of nitroglycerin
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake; counsel on heart-healthy diet. Monitor blood pressure.

caution_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented products)
caution_foods.mechanism: Potential for hypertensive response when combined with vasodilators in susceptible patients
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; monitor for headache or blood pressure elevation.

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure closely, especially at treatment initiation and with any new supplements or dietary changes. Counsel patients that PDE-5 inhibitors are absolutely contraindicated due to life-threatening hypotension risk; this is the critical safety issue with nitroglycerin use.
